market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: No NHL team has a 37.5% chance to win the Stanley Cup in a 32-team league; even the strongest favourites rarely exceed ~12-15%. The Hurricanes are a consistent playoff team but have repeatedly failed to reach the final, and they face stiff competition from elite Eastern and Western teams. This market price is massively overvaluing Carolina.
evidence_points: Preseason Cup odds for the top favourite usually sit around +900 to +1200 (implied ~8-10%)
Hurricanes lost in the second round in 2024 and haven't advanced past the conference finals since 2019
Roster has goaltending concerns (Andersen's age, Kochetkov's inconsistency) and potential free agency losses
sources_consulted: The Athletic and MoneyPuck pre-season Cup odds (2024-25)
General knowledge of NHL competitive balance and parity
